user.title: Ryde Waste Collection
user.description:
Enter your address in the City of Ryde LGA to track waste collection schedules.

Format: '128 Blaxland Road Ryde 2112' (do not include NSW).

You will confirm the matched address on the next step.

This is an unofficial integration and is not affiliated with Ryde Council.

select_address.title: Select address
select_address.description: Confirm the address Ryde Council matched. If several are listed, choose the correct one.

error.address_not_found: Address not found in Ryde Council's system. Please check the address and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Ryde Council API. Please try again later.
